tex_content.html:
Definition

Source: topping:page-0055 1. ch4:2.1\group topping-pde-existence For the scalar operator $L$ above, its principal symbol is the function $\sigma (L):T^*\M \to \mathbb R$ given in local coordinates by \[ \sigma (L)(x,\xi )=a_{ij}(x)\xi _i\xi _j. \] Equivalently, if $d\phi (x)=\xi $ for smooth $\phi ,f:\M \to \mathbb R$, then \[ \sigma (L)(x,\xi )f(x) =\lim _{s\to \infty }s^{-2}e^{-s\phi (x)}L(e^{s\phi }f)(x). \tag {4.2.2} \]
